results.name: basal
results.note: 3D width divided by shadow pixel pitch is an upper bound on projected width. Tips at zero width excluded; not a pixel-area or temporal flicker metric.

findings: Many actual blade cross-sections remain narrower than one shadow texel even at the largest possible root scale and most favorable projection. Wind can toggle these binary depth samples; PCF filters their coverage but cannot reconstruct the missing silhouette.
Color and depth share ecoBend and uniform objects; the existing absolute-time wind interpolation fix is already present. This diagnostic does not exclude all other causes.
status: Unresolved. No density, geometry, shadow resolution, bias, filter radius, wind strength or defaults changed.
next: Prototype a separately fitted close-range vegetation shadow with unchanged existing cascades, resolving the occupied-room 16-sampler constraint first. Validate fixed-time moving silhouettes and GPU cost before adoption.
